Casework by class-size distribution:

- Distribution \(2,2,0\): choose the empty class \(3\) ways; split 4 students into two ordered pairs for the two remaining classes: \(\binom{4}{2}=6\) ways. Total \(3\cdot 6=18\).

- Distribution \(2,1,1\): choose the class receiving 2 students \(3\) ways; choose those 2 students \(\binom{4}{2}=6\) ways; assign the remaining 2 students to the other two classes \(2!\) ways. Total \(3\cdot 6\cdot 2=36\).

Total valid ways: \(18+36=54\).

\[
\boxed{54}
\]
